The '''Dark Cat Tree''' is a piece of decorative [[furniture]] that can be purchased from [[Marnie's Ranch]] for {{Price|10000}}, when [[Marnie]] is tending the shop, or any time if the player has acquired the [[Animal Catalogue]]. It occupies a 2x1 space.

==Note==
Animals do not interact with it.
